spec.title: "Idle in TX" (max.)
spec.description: Open transactions where no queries are being executed. Bad for the database health generally.

spec.title: WAL archiving status
spec.description: WAL archiving failures can result in filled disk space

spec.title: Temp. bytes written (tot.)
spec.description: For selected timeframe. Postgres writes temporary files to disk when sorting / grouping  big amounts of data that doesn't fit into "work_mem" / ""maintenance_work_mem"

spec.title: Seq. scans on >100 MB tables (tot.)
spec.description: For selected timeframe. Frequent sequential scans on bigger tables should usually be avoided.

spec.title: Longest AUTOVACUUM duration (1d)
spec.description: Long running AUTOVACUUM processes can hint at workload or configuration  problems

spec.title: Tuples fetched vs returned
spec.description: Percentage of rows touched by queries that are actually returned to the client. Low numbers (< 10%) for an OLTP workload can hint at missing indexes

spec.title: Max. table FREEZE age
spec.description: Max. age since last VACUUM FREEZE. Could hint at problems when going into 100s of millions

spec.title: Max. session XMIN horizon age
spec.description: In TX. Holds back VACUUM. 1 million warning threshold

spec.title: Replication lag (max.)
spec.description: "Apply" (data made visible to queries on replica)  lag in bytes

spec.title: Backup duration (1d)
spec.description: Based on db_stats.backup_duration_s  / pg_backup_start_time() [9.3+] function. N/A if no backup in progress.

spec.title: Inactive repl. slots
spec.description: Inactive repl. slots accumulate WAL files until disk space runs out. Re-animate the replica or use  pg_drop_replication_slot() to remove the slot so that Postgres can delete the un-needed WALs.

spec.title: Shared Buffers hit pct. (avg.)
spec.description: Shared Buffers is the Postgres -managed file cache and 90%+ is what you normally want to see for best performance.
